controls.positive: Andrews-Gordon products against sums; the formula against the independent chart

notes: The class's own traces ARE this formula (its Layer 2), so (a) is a transcription check; the BPS chart, whose trace comes from its quiver and spec, is the independent comparison.

checks.name: positive control: the Andrews-Gordon products equal the Andrews-Gordon sums, k <= 3, every s, through q^30
the draft's T_0..T_k equal the class's elementary traces through fq^40, k = 1..6: 6 of 6

the BPS chart's Tr(1) and Tr(L_(a;i)) equal the draft's T_0 and T_a for every rotation index i, and the reduction algorithm's Sum c_s T_s equals the BPS chart's trace on every label of at most two letters: k=1: {'Tr(1) to fq^12': True, 'Tr(L_(a;i)) = T_a for every i': '[5] of 5 each', 'reduction on labels of <= 2 letters to fq^10': '16/16'}; k=2: {'Tr(1) to fq^10': True, 'Tr(L_(a;i)) = T_a for every i': '[7, 7] of 7 each', 'reduction on labels of <= 2 letters to fq^8': '85/85'}; k=3: {'Tr(1) to fq^8': True, 'Tr(L_(a;i)) = T_a for every i': '[9, 9, 9] of 9 each', 'reduction on labels of <= 2 letters, the first at rotation 0, to fq^6': '80/80'}
negative control: with m(a) = a in place of the draft's m(a), the formula disagrees with the BPS chart on k=1: 0 of 1, k=2: 2 of 2, k=3: 3 of 3 elementary traces (at k = 1 the two coincide)
